content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body: Hello, thank you for sending over the paperwork. I have reviewed the agreement and would like to propose a minor adjustment before signing: - Regarding the relevant clause on payment terms, waiting 90 days creates a significant cash flow burden, and I propose we change the payment terms from Net 90 to Net 30. Thank you for your flexibility and best regards.
